notes.title: Update 0.13 - Fishy Crabs
notes.notes:
A Quick stroll to the beach ended up being a journey of new army inventions. Instead of using mechnical machines, this king believed the way to victory was taming the ordinary seeming wildlife. He also brought back some big rocks...


Balance Adjustments

Queen cost: 18 -> 20


Added

New Piece: Flying fish, think a further reaching knight with less connected coverage

New Piece: Crab, though the humble crab cannot advance, it does skittle side to side and snip at anything close

New Piece: Rock, yup its just a rock. No rocks cannot suddenly move or capture. It doesn't cost anything as its just a rock... 

New Achievements: Mom get the camera, My board my way

Tutorial hints: short hints for new players (can be reset from menu)

Background image to forge



Removed

Resolution options, (this is now replaced by Fullscreen or a resizable window)



Changed

Resolution options, (this is now replaced by Fullscreen or a resizable window)

Formations will now be unusable if they don't obey the current patches rules

Game should start in Fullscreen for new players

Audio options now immediately change sound instead of having to apply

Update win/loss screen to be a little clearer

Game Icons



Fixed

Excessive board offset in match

Bot achievement gained on loss

Fixed randomly being able to promote the dragon

Leaderboard names not loading

Wrong initial screen size

Corrupt game end path

notes.title: Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
Scouts have just come back from their excursion, all data indicates that there the fields of battle will soon be filled. The kings are set to clash their forces, in the coming months. Who will come out on top, nobody knows. How the various kings will ensure their victory is unclear, there will be many battles and opportunities for kings to come out on top.



Release date: November 19th



Before then be sure to check out the demo, let us know if you have any thoughts or suggestions, feedback is always welcome.

notes.title: Update 0.12 - Dragons Dominion
notes.notes:
It seems someone has managed to tame the beast beyond the lands, how shalt thou old formations fare against such a creature that breathes fire when coxed from its lair... How will the other kings react to this advancement?  



Added

Challenging friends, you can now challenge your online friends from the play menu

New Piece: Dragon, breathes fire consuming the 3 pieces in front cone.. will destroy your own units

Ability to quit AI games without surrendering

Boxy UI Rework

Pieces should now interact with certain lighting effects. E.g. the dragons breath

Background image for match

Display animations for the menus

Ability to cancel selecting formation

New icons for UI

Piece info now shows cost

Additional tooltips for main menu buttons

Intro animation (yes this is skippable, cause un-skippable intros are very annoying IMO)



Removed

Depreciated networking features, these were left around from when the game was on itch instead of steam. removing them means they can't sneak any bugs into out formation and leads to a smaller download



Changed

Font & Sizes

Starting information for piece info card is now clear

Unit placer size

Formation select triggers on enter key



Fixed

Various issues with the new tamed beast (dragon)

Pieces not being taken vs AI

Status icon not showing correctly

Re-joining outdated lobbies in certain circumstances

Duplicate names showing in matches

notes.title: Update 0.11 - Assassins Ascent
notes.notes:
Across Chessland kings compete for more than just land and resources, now the fight brings glory and renown to those that best their opponents. Who shall rise to the top and how will their fight to stay there play out?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685218/83dd2f1097ff0c3124c2f74f20b0f4d346329bbe.png"]

This update main appeal is the introduction of ranked, with leaderboards for the top 10 players too.

Due to player count only 1 game mode and time format will be available at a time. Since we have added ranked, this updates mode will be ranked on rapid time (15m).



Added

New piece: Assassin, a costly but deadly piece that can quickly move behind any open space behind a piece, capturing 3 squares behind

Unit information in the forge

Game type display at the top of matches

ELO V2: Elo is more fairly calculated and "exchanged"

AI V2: This AI has a very naïve understanding of board value, which means they are much more aggressive when they can take a piece

New challenge: How will your build fair to a queen filled attack? 

Titles: Show off your flavour of tile, currently only 2 for owning either the demo or full game. Will be more in the future. (if you see "developer" then you are playing against our team)

Board textures: You can now choose from a set of board textures in the settings. E.g. Wood, stone, default

Ranked: Winning/Losing means more internet points, yay-yay

Leaderboards: Top 10 Global

New animations: Board/piece load

Changed

Matchmaking: Uses additional filters in the background to speed up queue times

Bigegg can no longer promote into itself

Allow right click to stop placing piece in forge

Searching now shows game mode

Removed AA from pieces, resulting in slightly sharper icons

Options and forge now give feedback on actions

Fixed

Connecting to old games

Settings not being defined

Cured AI analysis paralysis

Issues with going between bot and online matches

Surrendering sometimes not working

Pieces being invisible when placed

Tiling of scrolling main menu background

notes.title: Patch 0.10.6
notes.notes:
Big eggs were behaving weirdly, somehow using the enemies power against them. Though this look like it was a short lived advantage and whatever magic fuelling it fades.


 Added

Ability to pin unit information screen during match, simply click to lock/unlock which stops it from moving offscreen so you can always see the detailed information

Exit game button on main menu

Version matching: You will now need to be on the same version to matchmake, from this version on players will be separated by version.

Fixed

Missing library capsule image

Game not winning upon capturing in some cases

Win/loss counting as 2 in some cases

big egg not using your own units for potential promotion

notes.title: Update 0.10.5
notes.notes:
Many new players enter the increasing battles across Chessland, attempting to seize power. For now we can be confidant that they are merrily trying to gauge the strength of their own forces and test new compositions. Though I would warn everyone to keep your key on them, as those that appear weak today are likely to improve an untold amount.


This update is focused on improving the game for the Demo. I've added in challenges, import/export of formations, many fixes... No new pieces yet though, they are still in the works.


Added

Profile section: Elo, Wins, Loss, Played (Elo is currently only a testing stat and will not effect matchmaking, stats currently count AI games)

Challenges: These are preset formations to fight, Though you can use any formation you craft against them. The AI is very dumb but in the future these will be much harder and tied to achievements

Debug export: This is mainly for testing, won't be offering support for running/using this for the time being

Wishlist button: This will only be visible on the demo, takes you to the steam page

More play settings: time format, stating color

Import/Export: You can now import and export your formations from the forge. Allowing to share a formation with a friend.

Forge Visual Piece Placer: Now a little piece follows your mouse when placing a piece in the forge, look at him chase your mouse... funny little guy

Changed

AI doesn't copy your formation anymore, will use presets

About section uses markdown and offers a more readable entry, as well as direct links. Like other people who have put out work used in this game. Give them all some love!

Sliders, settings menu got a slight visual update

Removed general setting, as this isn't currently used for anything

Fixed

AI being unnamed in practice

Fixed winning adding to your stats duplicate times

Tooltip spelling

Endless game when opponent disconnects

Stats disappearing after first load

Both players starting game as same color

Re-joining expired games

Searching breaking after playing game
